Class BasicTextToolBox

java.lang.Object
com.the_ultimate_toolbox.api.textToolbox.BasicTextToolBox
public class BasicTextToolBox extends Object
This class, BasicTextToolBox, provides a set of utility methods for manipulating and testing strings.

  • Method Details

    • removeEspecialCharacters

      public static String removeEspecialCharacters(String str)
      This method removes all special characters from a given string. It first normalizes the string using Normalizer.normalize() method and then removes all diacritical marks using a regular expression.
      Parameters:
      str - The input string from which special characters need to be removed.
      Returns:
      The output string with all special characters removed.

    • isNumeric

      public static boolean isNumeric(String strNum)
      This method checks if a given string is numeric or not. It tries to parse the string into a double and returns true if the parsing is successful, otherwise it returns false.
      Parameters:
      strNum - The input string to be checked for numeric value.
      Returns:
      True if the string is numeric, false otherwise.

    • stringArrayInicialize

      public static String[] stringArrayInicialize(int size)
      This method initializes a string array of a given size with empty strings.
      Parameters:
      size - The size of the string array to be initialized.
      Returns:
      The initialized string array.

    • containsOnlyLetters

      public static boolean containsOnlyLetters(String test)
      This method checks if a given string contains only letters or not. It uses a regular expression to match the string against only letters.
      Parameters:
      test - The input string to be checked for only letters.
      Returns:
      True if the string contains only letters, false otherwise.

    • floatFromString

      public static double floatFromString(String str)
      This method returns a float value from a given string. If the string is null or cannot be parsed into a float, it returns 0.0.
      Parameters:
      str - The input string from which a float value needs to be extracted.
      Returns:
      The float value extracted from the string.

    • removeCharacterFromString

      public static String removeCharacterFromString(String s, char c)
      This method removes a given character from a string. It uses a StringBuilder to build the output string by iterating through each character in the input string and appending it to the StringBuilder only if it's not the character to be removed.
      Parameters:
      s - The input string from which a character needs to be removed.
      c - The character to be removed from the string.
      Returns:
      The output string with the character removed.

    • isPalindrome

      public static boolean isPalindrome(String str)
      This method checks if a given string is a palindrome or not. It creates a reversed string from the input string and checks if both strings are equal or not.
      Parameters:
      str - The input string to be checked for palindrome.
      Returns:
      True if the string is a palindrome, false otherwise.
